decision_question: Can a future promoted V2 runtime keep authenticated fill receipt, fee accounting, and position economics aligned with the frozen fee-aware replay contract?

defects.fee_source: The live reconciler priced a fill only from the legacy top-level fee_rate_bps field. Current V2 fees are market parameters applied at match time, and the canonical user-channel trade shape does not guarantee that field, so a taker fill could be recorded with zero fee.
defects.gamma_schema: Current Gamma markets publish orderPriceMinTickSize and nested feeSchedule.rate, but the parser recognized only older tick and fee aliases.
defects.maker_fill_economics: A managed maker order was filled with the aggregate taker size and price instead of its own maker_orders matched_amount and price leg.
defects.heartbeat: The authenticated user channel sent an empty JSON object although the documented heartbeat is the literal PING message.
defects.trade_lifecycle: MATCHED, MINED, and CONFIRMED reuse one trade id. Booking at MATCHED and deduplicating only by id made a later FAILED transition invisible.

repair_contract.fee_schedule: Parse the current Gamma feeSchedule.rate field, snapshot the effective maker or taker rate with each pending managed order, compute the official five-decimal fee from the confirmed fill economics, and trip the breaker rather than booking an invalid or schedule-less fill.
repair_contract.tick_metadata: Parse orderPriceMinTickSize in addition to the existing Gamma aliases.
repair_contract.maker_leg: Reconcile a managed maker order from its own maker_orders matched_amount and price; retain aggregate trade economics only for the taker order id.
repair_contract.heartbeat: Send literal PING every ten seconds on the authenticated user channel.
repair_contract.terminality: Keep MATCHED and MINED as pending exposure and book financial state only at terminal CONFIRMED; process terminal FAILED before id deduplication can hide it.

deployed_measurement_v9.scoring_requirement: v9 retains the schema-4 reproduction-hardened scorer and may score the sealed block only after the fixed 750-condition floor.
deployed_measurement_v9.promotion_requirement: Any future production runtime must retain the v9 reconciliation contract or a later hash-pinned equivalent and add automated authenticated REST recovery before live promotion.

validation.cargo_test: PASS: 510 passed (459 library + 51 binary), 0 failed; doc-tests 0
validation.cargo_clippy: PASS: all targets with warnings denied after allowing the two documented pre-existing unrelated lints

known_remaining_boundary.impact: A disconnect or an event that arrives before the venue order id is acknowledged can still require authenticated REST order/trade recovery. The client exposes read-only order and trade endpoints, but the live pipeline does not yet run that recovery loop.
known_remaining_boundary.promotion_effect: live promotion remains blocked until reconnect/startup recovery is implemented and tested; paper-only operation and the measurement canary are unaffected

decision.next_step: Continue sealed collection to 750 and score exactly once. In parallel, implement and test authenticated REST startup/reconnect recovery before any production live promotion; do not replace the paper-only production binary from this amendment.
